ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Первое воспитание» (pervoye vospitaniye, 'first upbringing') is rendered "early upbringing" throughout; «самоотречение» (samootrecheniye, 'self-denial') and «воздержание» (vozderzhaniye, 'abstinence') are kept literal. Mazzini's attribution is given as Giuseppe Mazzini and Muhammad's, printed without a final period, is left without one.
Source observation: [14] The Russian prints «— э *то добродетельная женщина*» with the italics breaking inside «это» ('this is'); a transcription slip in the markup. Translated as one italic line.
